info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Loan Management API
info.description: The Consumer Loan Management API provides functionality for modifying existing consumer loan details within the banking system. This endpoint allows authorized users to update specific parameters of a loan, enhancing the accuracy of loan records and ensuring compliance with ongoing regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include financial institutions and internal banking teams managing loan products. Use cases involve adjusting loan terms, interest rates, or borrower information to reflect current situations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the details of a specific consumer loan identified by its loan ID. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to update the loan information accordingly.

requestBody.description: Patch request to update specific attributes of the consumer loan identified by LOAN-500045. Only the fields that need to be updated should be included in the request body.
